settings.viz_style.label: Visualizer style
settings.viz_style.description: Style of the live visualizer in the player panel: 'wave' (smooth wave line), 'spectrum' (dual-line spectrum) or 'bars' (animated bars).
settings.progress_style.label: Progress bar style
settings.progress_style.description: Style of the track time bar: 'plain' (straight bar with a round knob), 'wavy' (animated wave of bars, filled up to the current position) or 'unique' (like plain but slightly thicker with a stick handle instead of a knob).
settings.button_style.label: Button style
settings.button_style.description: Transport control style drawn with ui surfaces: 'm3' (Material 3 Expressive shapes: circle, rounded-square, pills), 'classic' (squares with slightly rounded corners) or 'round' (perfect circles).
settings.glass_enabled.label: Glass effect
settings.glass_enabled.description: Frosted-glass background for the player panel: translucent surface with a soft blur.
settings.glass_blur.label: Glass blur
settings.glass_blur.description: Blur strength of the glass background (softness, 0–60). 0 disables the blur.
settings.glass_opacity.label: Glass opacity
settings.glass_opacity.description: How opaque the glass background is, in percent (5–95). Lower = more transparent.
settings.show_art_in_bar.label: Show cover in the bar
settings.show_art_in_bar.description: Show the album cover thumbnail (or a music-note fallback) next to the track title in the top bar widget.
settings.bar_title_width.label: Bar title width
settings.bar_title_width.description: Maximum number of characters of the track title shown in the bar widget before truncation (8–60).
